description: Source code for an Android Fragment and associated Preview class that manage camera preview functionality, including camera switching and display centering.

classes.name: CameraFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages camera lifecycle, switching between cameras, and integrates with the Preview class for displaying camera feed.

classes.name: Preview
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that wraps a SurfaceView to display a centered camera preview, handling camera parameter configuration and aspect ratio adjustments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes camera and preview setup, identifies default rear camera.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Returns the Preview view for display.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Opens the selected camera and attaches it to the preview.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates camera switch menu if multiple cameras are available.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles camera switching and navigation actions.
